Our mission is to build the best modern financial software for global businesses.

product.name: Mass Payments
product.description: A service that enables businesses to send payments to multiple vendors simultaneously, automating and scaling payment processes.

product.name: Automated Tax Compliance
product.description: A service that collects tax forms (W8s and W9s) and generates 1099 forms to simplify end-of-year tax filing.

product.name: Global Payment API
product.description: An API that allows businesses to customize and automate their payment workflows with tailored payment experiences.

product.name: Global Payouts
product.description: A service enabling businesses to pay vendors worldwide in their local currencies across 34+ currencies.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: Reliable integrations that sync payment data with existing accounting software to maintain accurate financial records.

product.name: Custom Controls and Approvals
product.description: Features that allow businesses to set payment controls and approval workflows matching their internal processes.
